| Category = Sauce recipes
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*1 head of [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
*[[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
*20 [[Cookbook:Culantro|culantro]] leaves—find this at local Latin or Asian markets
*1 small bunch of [[Cookbook:Cilantro|cilantro]]
*1 large green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], seeded, [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] and with the white pith from the inside of the pepper removed.
*13–15 large sweet [[Cookbook:Chiles|aji peppers]], seeded
*2 small Spanish [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], diced

==Procedure==
#Slice off the top of the head of garlic to expose some of the cloves inside. Place the head on a piece of [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|foil]]. Drizzle with olive oil and wrap in the foil. [[Cookbook:Roasting|Roast]] until cloves are lightly browned and tender, about 30 minutes. 
#Remove the roasted garlic from the oven and simply pop the individual cloves out of the roasted paper outers. They should come out easily.
#Combine 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] roasted garlic, culantro, cilantro, bell pepper, aji pepper, and onion in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]] or [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]].
#Pulse 15 times or until consistency is almost smooth.
